result.summary: Found 1 issue: a major content problem with a meaningless '-0%' discount badge. Otherwise the page layout appears intact, excluding expected scrollable-row and bottom-viewport clipping.

issues.description: Discount badge on the partially visible pizza card at the bottom shows '-0%', which is a meaningless/broken placeholder value and implies a discount that does not exist.
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount badge when the discount is 0%, or fix the promotion data/calculation so the badge displays the correct discount percentage.
